# Screens
{: .no_toc }

Every screen in the Substratal Hub, with the same ID, route and behavior in all six apps (Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS/iPadOS, Android and Web). Each has its own help page at `/screens/<id>/`, which every app links to from its Help button or **F1**.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

Generated from the [specs package](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps-applications-specs) at `cebf679`. A machine-readable list is at [`screens.json`]({{ '/screens.json' | relative_url }}).

| ID | Screen | Route | Who | Apps |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AUTH-01]({{ '/screens/auth-01/' | relative_url }}) | Sign in | `/sign-in` | Unauthenticated | All Hub apps |
| [AUTH-02]({{ '/screens/auth-02/' | relative_url }}) | Two-factor challenge | `/sign-in/mfa` | Holder of mfa_token | All Hub apps |
